faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CCRYN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 vacancies: 1 Consultant Physician (Y&N)- Male, 2 Yoga Therapist (01 Male + 01 Female), 1 Assistant Consultant Accounts, 2 Office Assistant, 1 Senior Office Assistant, 1 Maintenance Senior Engineer and 4 more posts.

faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 26 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.answer: It depends on the post: 50,000 (Consolidated) for Consultant Physician (Y&N)- Male, 38,000 (Consolidated) for Yoga Therapist (01 Male + 01 Female), 45,000 for Assistant Consultant Accounts, 24,356 for Office Assistant, 30,000 for Senior Office Assistant.
